samplingRule: Sort active MCP Registry servers (npm/pypi, public GitHub, verified MIT or Apache-2.0, excluding Vambrace fixtures and typescript-sdk examples) ascending by sha256("20261123:<lang>:<registryName>:<repoUrl>"). Take first N per language and assign first round(N * 0.6) servers to dev, remaining to test.
note: Real-world Python MCP servers sampled from the official MCP Registry. Run node bench/fetch.mjs to clone pinned commits into bench/.cache/. Test-split labels remain outside this repository.
